QuestInfo.name: The Demon's Lair 3
QuestInfo.0: The allies are on the road to victory, but Nobunaga has more tricks up his sleeve.
QuestInfo.1: Enter the temple and defeat Takigawa Kazumasu, one of Oda's Four Heavenly Kings.
QuestInfo.2: With Kazumasu down and Honnou-ji back under your control, you can only wonder where Nobunaga has fled. He and his cronies have escaped for now... but they will face their judgment.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 9,575,667 Can proceed to The End of an Era quest

0.0: There's only one thing left to do. Defeat Takigawa Kazumasu and reclaim Honnou-ji. The enemy resistance should fall apart without Kazumasu.
0.1: Kazumasu is yours, Kanna. Do your worst.

yes.0: Kazumasu is hiding in Honnou-ji Temple. He knows the end is coming. Don't let him down!

no.0: We don't have much time. Please think of the ramifications.

default.0: Enemy general Takigawa Kazumasu is in the temple. Defeat him and end this battle!
